Clause 9.28.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect and preserve the identified period buildings within the precinct and 
encourage their sympathetic alteration or restoration.

Clause 9.28.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect the identified  Heritage Items  within the precinct.

Clause 9.28.2 - height_limit (development_control): To maintain distinctly single storey streetscapes that exist within the precinct.

Clause 9.28.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect groups or runs of building which retain their original built form including roof forms, original detailing and finishes.

Clause 9.28.2 - heritage (heritage): To prot ect significa nt streetscape s and/or public domain elements within the 
precinct including landscaping, fencing, open space, sandstone kerbing and guttering, views and vistas and prevailing subdivision patterns.

Clause 9.28.2 - other (development_control): Retain existing views and vistas to open space  areas adjace nt to the Cooks River 
and maintai n public access to tho se areas.

Clause 9.28.2 - other (development_control): To ensure that new  development in the foreshore area will not impact on natural 
foreshore processes or affect the significance and amenity of the area.

Clause 9.28.2 - zoning (land_use_zoning): To preserve the predominan tly low and m edium density residential character of 
the precinct.
